name: addresses are lower-cased, de-duplicated and sorted
block goes after the leading requires, not before
several require commands, comments between them, a semicolon inside a string
no require: the block goes to the very top, before the user rules
quotes, backslashes and brackets in data are escaped and read back
present block is replaced in place, user rules untouched
empty list removes the block and leaves the rest
empty list on a script without the block changes nothing
